objective: Test whether a burst-focused detector-only residual CNN learns useful corrections under the declared synthetic spatial common-cause noise, on paired development samples.

circuit.burst_injection: Stim CORRELATED_ERROR X8 X10 immediately after each MR boundary; five independent Bernoulli sites

burst_informed_pymatching.construction: same base circuit with declared p=0.01 X8X10 burst at each MR boundary
burst_informed_pymatching.noise_information: privileged; receives exact synthetic burst probability and location

historical_residual_cnn.weights: Stage 2 saved historical_residual_position_cnn checkpoint for the matched root
historical_residual_cnn.selection: Stage 2 frozen temperature and threshold; no Stage 3 refit

stage3_correlation_focused_residual_cnn.architecture: same 13,429-parameter historical residual-position CNN; no architecture expansion
inference_inputs: 40 detector bits in Stim detector geometry

training.balancing_scope: only the synthetic-burst training partition; 50/50 residual positives and negatives, replacement for the minority class
training.natural_prevalence_logit_correction: add the logit of each root's natural residual-positive prevalence from its training partition before temperature scaling
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum monitor residual NLL; ties retain earliest epoch; restore best weights before calibration
training.failure_action_below_minimum: stop without top-up or use of final-development labels

selection.temperature_objective: minimum root-specific probability-calibration NLL; ties nearest 1, then lower
selection.threshold_objective: one global threshold minimizing Stage 3 candidate LER on the burst threshold-selection partitions pooled across five roots; ties nearest 0.5, then lower
selection.historical_cnn_selection: use Stage 2 frozen weights, temperature and threshold without refitting
selection.final_development_rule: persist all five restored candidate checkpoints, temperatures, the single global threshold and model hashes before generating either final-development condition; final labels are used only for scoring and independent rescoring

analysis.primary_estimand: mean across five independent roots of (Stage 3 CNN burst-condition LER minus nominal fixed PyMatching burst-condition LER)
analysis.primary_uncertainty: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over five root-level paired differences, descriptive feasibility interval only
secondary_estimands: candidate minus nominal fixed on nominal control
candidate minus frozen historical CNN on both conditions
burst-informed PyMatching minus nominal fixed on burst samples

development_success_gate.interpretation: development feasibility only; passing is not independent confirmation and does not authorize test access

analysis.inference_policy: apply no correction unless the residual score crosses the frozen threshold; this is a fixed learned correction rule, not regime adaptation

claims_boundary: This is a development feasibility experiment on a synthetic burst model, not a confirmatory test, hardware result or novelty claim.
